content.text: It is not yet clear whether it is appropriate to reintroduce those commits or whether a completely different approach is needed.
In any event, that PR is not an appropriate place to start work on this ticket. It contains fundamental misunderstandings.

, From my testing, your initial PR modeled blank nodes very well. The only missing element was full-resource replacement with PUT. Are you suggesting there is a more significant "misunderstanding"? Can you elaborate on the short-comings of your initial approach?

No, it is your PR which misunderstands my commits. Besides my objection to restarting this work without a much more serious conversation with the community, what I'm saying is that either we start from my commits, or we start fresh, but not from your PR. You pulled deskolemization out of the internal processing for updates, and that's not at all how the types I built are to work. We could take some completely different approach (and maybe should), but starting from your PR is going to confuse the code.
Also, PATCH that altered properties on blank nodes didn't work. That's why
found the bug originally.
I have grave reservations about blank nodes, as you know, but if we're going to go anywhere near them, I have even graver reservations about
mutable
blank nodes.
What is the status of this ticket? Are we really going to revisit supporting blank nodes? (I hope not)
No intention of revisiting blank nodes at this point.
Thank you,
"Our long national nightmare is over."
This task is to reintroduce the following commits:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/ceacc9832890906c8dee8f4533f5b33679d9b875
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/commit/03c2bef5aa68ef224a86aa432d5ecfb378ff7c99
That were reverted with these commits:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/ae5aa5d2b2cafc8ebcb67baf226e57547e81bc5d
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/commit/578626c0b8ff602920e95b78697dfba72a612d54
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/commit/c507414f4c9489a71291386c09f06525a6f1e666
Because PATCH and PUT were not yet supported.
An initial cut at a PATCH fix can be found in this PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/786

It is not yet clear whether it is appropriate to reintroduce those commits or whether a completely different approach is needed.

In any event, that PR is not an appropriate place to start work on this ticket. It contains fundamental misunderstandings.

A. Soroka, From my testing, your initial PR modeled blank nodes very well. The only missing element was full-resource replacement with PUT. Are you suggesting there is a more significant "misunderstanding"? Can you elaborate on the short-comings of your initial approach?

No, it is your PR which misunderstands my commits. Besides my objection to restarting this work without a much more serious conversation with the community, what I'm saying is that either we start from my commits, or we start fresh, but not from your PR. You pulled deskolemization out of the internal processing for updates, and that's not at all how the types I built are to work. We could take some completely different approach (and maybe should), but starting from your PR is going to confuse the code.

Also, PATCH that altered properties on blank nodes didn't work. That's why Unknown found the bug originally.

I have grave reservations about blank nodes, as you know, but if we're going to go anywhere near them, I have even graver reservations about mutable blank nodes.
What is the status of this ticket? Are we really going to revisit supporting blank nodes? (I hope not)
No intention of revisiting blank nodes at this point.

Thank you, Andrew Woods.

"Our long national nightmare is over."
